title: Nocturnal epilepsy and Mallworld
content: I’ve gotten some negativity here before for suggesting that we may be experiencing neurological issues, but please do look into this before breaking out the pitchforks! Apparently, the vivid dreams themselves can be a type of not-so-serious seizure that can develop into more serious seizures over time if left untreated. Additionally, having seizures during sleep drastically increases the chances of sudden death, especially if left untreated. I’ve been visiting Mallworld for maybe 10-12 years, and started waking up to focal seizures a couple months ago (aware, no convulsions). A couple nights ago, I ended up falling out of bed after what I assume was a tonic or tonic-clonic seizure (“grand mal”) during my sleep. Which was alarming, to say the least. Epilepsy is probably not the case for everyone here, but I am starting to believe it to be my issue and root cause of my Mallworld, so I’m sharing this in case it helps anyone. I would have never considered this for myself before the more obvious seizures started.
